## Checklist

- [ ] `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` passes
- [ ] Any rate, lot size, holiday or rule change cites an **official source** below, and the as-of date is updated
- [ ] New or changed numbers have a test that pins a hand-checked value
- [ ] Scripts stay standard-library only (no new dependencies)
- [ ] No API keys, tokens, personal data or real account statements are included
